lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
couplets.en: My love, do not ask me to love you as I once did.

lines: Main ne samjha tha ke tu hai to darakhshan hai hayat
couplets.en: I thought your presence made life shine.

lines: Tera gham hai to gham-e-dahr ka jhagra kya hai
couplets.en: With the sorrow of loving you, what had I to do with the cares of the world?

lines: Teri surat se hai aalam mein baharon ko sabaat
couplets.en: It was your face that gave spring in this world its staying power.

lines: Teri aankhon ke siwa duniya mein rakha kya hai
couplets.en: What could the world hold for me beyond your eyes?

lines: Tu jo mil jaye to taqdeer nigoon ho jaye
couplets.en: If I could be with you, fate itself would bow.

lines: Yun na tha, main ne faqat chaha tha yun ho jaye
couplets.en: It was never so, I only wished it might be.

lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
couplets.en: My love, do not ask me to love you as I once did.

lines: Anginat sadiyon ke tareek bahimana tilism
couplets.en: Countless centuries have cast their dark and brutal spells.
They have had those spells woven into silk, satin and brocade.

lines: Ja-ba-ja bikte hue kucha-o-bazaar mein jism
couplets.en: Everywhere, bodies are sold in the lanes and markets.

lines: Khaak mein lithre hue, khoon mein nahlaye hue
couplets.en: They are smeared with dust and bathed in blood.

lines: Laut jati hai udhar ko bhi nazar, kya kije
couplets.en: My gaze keeps returning there too, what can I do?

lines: Ab bhi dilkash hai tera husn, magar kya kije
couplets.en: Your beauty still draws me, but what can I do?

lines: Aur bhi dukh hain zamane mein mohabbat ke siwa
couplets.en: There are other sorrows in the world besides love.

lines: Rahatein aur bhi hain wasl ki rahat ke siwa
couplets.en: There are other comforts besides the comfort of being together.

lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
couplets.en: My love, do not ask me to love you as I once did.
